mission.title: helm: MaxDecompressedFileSize in v3.17.3 breaks existing charts
mission.description: MaxDecompressedFileSize in v3.17.3 breaks existing charts. This issue affects 60+ users.

steps.title: Identify helm upgrade symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your helm installation:
```bash
helm version --short
helm repo list
```
Look for errors or warnings that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review helm configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant helm configuration:
Version 3.17.3 is enforcing a maximum chart size which breaks existing helm charts.

steps.title: Apply the fix for MaxDecompressedFileSize in v3.17.3 breaks existing charts
steps.description:
Apply the configuration change to resolve the issue:
```yaml
helm template gloo-platform gloo-platform/gloo-platform --version=2.6.9 --set common.cluster=cluster1
```

steps.title: Confirm MaxDecompressedFileSize in v3.17.3 breaks… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
Test helm to confirm the issue is resolved.
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary: See the source issue for the community-verified solution: https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/30738
codeSnippets: Error: decompressed chart file "gloo-platform/values.schema.json" is larger than the maximum file size 5242880

helm fetch gloo-platform/gloo-platform --version 2.7.0
tar -xzvf gloo-platform-2.7.0.tgz
mv gloo-platform/values.schema.json /tmp/_values.schema.json
cat /tmp/_values.schema.json| jq -c > gloo-platform/values.schema.json

helm upgrade --install gloo-platform-mgmt ./gloo-platform
